# O12: Lost in the wash

Market: US. Winner since 2026-09. Pain: socks disappear in the laundry.

## Hook (0–3 s)

Spoken: "Where do your socks actually go in the wash?"
On screen: "The washer ate another sock"
Visual: close-up of a washing machine door opening, one single sock inside.

## Body (3–22 s)

"Every load, one sock goes missing. You end up with a drawer full of singles and
buy new packs every few months. SockLock socks have a tiny magnet on the cuff. Snap
the pair together before the wash, and they come out together. Every time."

Visual: hand snapping two socks together, laundry cycle in fast motion, pair coming
out of the dryer still connected.

## CTA (22–28 s)

"Take the 30-second quiz and get your first five pairs for $29."
On screen: "5 pairs. $29. Take the quiz"
